nav.title: Cibiyar Tuntuɓar AI
nav.subtitle: Sabis na kai-kai da harsuna daban-daban tare da miƙa wa mutum cikin kulawa.

status.apiUnavailable: Shiga / API ba a samu ba

stats.providerQualificationNote: Kawai harsuna da aka gwada da kansu suka ƙidaya
stats.liveQueue: Sake jiran mutane ta kan layi

customer.title: Fara tattaunawa
customer.consentText: Na yarda a cewar wannan tattaunawar za a bi ta ta hanyar mai bayarwa na AI. Rubutun za a ɓoye kafin ajiyewa.
customer.startChat: Fara tattaunawa da rubutu mai tsaro
customer.setupHint: Ba za a samu ba har sai mai gudanarwa ya saita maɓallin ɓoyewa da mai bayarwa na AI.
customer.startHint: Don farawa, ƙirƙiri zamanin da ka yarda.
customer.requestHuman: Nemi mai ba da taimako na mutum
customer.chatEmpty: Saƙonka za su bayyana nan. Ayyukan AI su ne shawarwari kawai; ba a yi biyan kuɗi, canjin asusun, mayar da kuɗi ko aika ba.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Ana watsa muryar burauza zuwa ga mai bayarwa da aka saita; OpsCore ba ya iƙirarin adana sautin da ba a sarrafa ba.
customer.voiceRequirement: Muryar burauza tana buƙatar HTTPS (ko localhost), makirufo, izini, tsarin Realtime da aka saita da mabuɗin mai bayarwa. Ba gadar wayar PSTN/SIP ba ce.

queue.title: Sake jiran ɗagawa
queue.description: Nan za ka ga tattaunawa da ke da haɗari, ba a warware su ko neman mutum. Abu a sake jira yana neman a nemi, ba a haɗa ba.
queue.empty: Babu miƙa wa mutum mai aiki ga wannan ƙungiya.
queue.replyStorageNote: Ana ɓoye amsoshin mutane lokacin adanawa kuma suna bayyana a rubutun tattaunawa.
queue.resolveNote: Ma'aikacin ɗan adam da aka ba wa aiki ya warware shi.

boundaries.title: Iyakokin aiki
boundaries.automateBody: Martani na farko da harsuna da yawa, bayyani, rarraba niyya da haɗari, adana rubutu mai tsaro, yin jerin da nadi na manyan mutane.
boundaries.humanTitle: Ana buƙatar mutum ya dauki alhaki
boundaries.humanBody: Buƙata ta bayyana ga mutum, ƙarancin gaskatawa, haɗari mai yawa ko mahimmanci, rashin manufofi, lamari da ba a warware ba, koka ta sirri/tsaro ko aiki mara tabbas.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: Ba zai iya faruwa da wannan kunshin kadai ba
boundaries.notEnabledBody: Hanya ta PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/imeel, gada ta waya ta kan layi, tabbatar da sanya hannu ta CRM da ikirarin ingancin harshe suna buƙatar daidaitaccen mahaɗan mai bayarwa, takaddun shaida da gwajin karɓa.

handoffReasons.unresolved: Matsala da ba a warware ba

messages.qualificationNotice: Babu harshe mai cancantar samarwa sai an tabbatar da gwajin rubutu, ASR, TTS, ladabi da ɗagawa.
messages.configOk: Saito yana. Haɗin mai bayarwa da ingancin harshe har yanzu suna buƙatar gwajin karɓa na gaskiya.
messages.conversationCreated: An ƙirƙiri tattaunawa mai tsaro. Ingancin harshe har yanzu ba a cancanta don samarwa.
messages.handoffQueued: Miƙa wa mutum an cika shi jerin ({reason}). Wannan buƙatar jerin ce, ba haɗin gaskiya ba.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Amsar AI ta kasa cika. Ba a aiwatar da wani aiki ba. Za ka iya neman mai bayarwa na mutum.
messages.apiUnavailable: Ba a iya loda API ɗin Cibiyar Tuntuɓa ba. Shiga cikin na'urar kula ta OpsCore, sannan sake loda wannan shafin.
messages.suggestedNextStep: Mataki na gaba da aka ba da shawara kawai (ba a aiwatar ba): {step}.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: An saka miƙa wa mutum a jerin gwano ({reason}). Jerin gwano ba ya tabbatar da cewa wakili ya haɗu.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: An saka miƙa wa mutum a jerin gwano. Ana dakatar da zaman AI na burauza; ba a saita canja wurin waya kai tsaye ba.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: Ana neman takardar shaidar murya ta ɗan gajeren lokaci…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Mai bayarwa na lokaci-na-gaske ya ba da rahoton kuskure. Dakatar da zaman murya kuma a sake gwadawa bayan duba saitin mai bayarwa.
messages.voiceActive: Zaman murya yana aiki. Danna “Nemi mai ba da taimako na mutum” a kowane lokaci; wannan yana ƙirƙirar abu a jerin gwano, ba canja wurin PSTN ba.
messages.voiceCredentialActive: {languageCode} · takardar shaida ta ɗan lokaci ta mai bayarwa

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Ana buƙatar izini kafin tattaunawa ta fara.
errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: Ba a iya karanta amsar sabar ba.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Ba a iya isa ga mai bayar da muryar lokaci-na-gaske ba.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Wannan burauzar ba ta goyi bayan muryar lokaci-na-gaske.
errors.HANDOFF_NOT_CLAIMED: Ba a iya karɓar miƙawar ba.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_DUPLICATE_MESSAGE: An yi watsi da saƙon da aka maimaita.
